title: Ukraine's heavy bomber drones airdrop ARK-1 mine-laying robots behind Russian lines
summary: Ukraine has reportedly used heavy bomber drones to transport ARK-1 robotic vehicles carrying anti-tank mines behind Russian lines. Footage released by the Russian military Telegram channel Arkhangel Spetsnaza appears to show a large hexacopter carrying the ground robot beneath it.
